title: Code and data for: Profile-likelihood inference for a satellite-constrained dual-timescale light-use-efficiency model of perennial canopy memory
description:
Code and data accompanying the article "Profile-likelihood inference for a satellite-constrained dual-timescale light-use-efficiency model of perennial canopy memory".

Contents

  • Dual-timescale light-use-efficiency model (fast leaf pool, slow crown-cover pool)
  • ERA5/ERA5-Land weather, Sentinel-2 NDVI and SoilGrids data for the study orchard (2020–2026)
  • Leave-one-year-out comparison, slow-pool ablation, sensitivity analyses, correlated-error observation model and profile likelihood
  • run_all.sh reproduces every result and figure; src/verify_paper.py checks all 194 numbers reported in the article
